CELL.

A California Education Learning Lab project developing and studying an AI coach for academic writing and digital literacy across public higher education.

View the official project overview →All projects

About the project

AI support designed with educators.

CELL brings together UCI, California State University Fullerton, and the North Orange County Community College District.

The team is iteratively developing, implementing, and evaluating AI-supported writing resources across California public higher education. The project combines PapyrusAI with professional development and faculty learning communities so the technology develops alongside teaching practice.

TimelineJanuary 2025 to December 2027
LearnersCalifornia public higher education students
FocusAcademic writing and digital literacy

Project design

Technology, research, and faculty learning together.

Develop the AI Coach

PapyrusAI provides a foundation for writing support that can be refined through classroom use.

Build Digital Literacy

Students learn to engage with AI critically, transparently, and productively as part of academic work.

Learn With Faculty

Professional development and faculty communities connect implementation with shared inquiry and improvement.
